newsitem.title: ESTONIA: INCREASED SALES BOOST NORMA'S H1 PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: INCREASED SALES BOOST NORMA'S H1 PROFIT.

text.p: Increased sales and a favourable U.S. dollar exchange rate boosted Norma's consolidated first half profit for 1997 to 64.6 million kroons, the company said on Wednesday.
In a statement the company said that sales of seat belts had exceeded forecasts by 3.1 million kroons due to the growth in seat belt orders and the favourable U.S. dollar rate.
Of the company's exports, 88 percent were to Eastern markets, ten percent to the Western markets and the remainder went to the Baltic market.
Norma's biggest customers in the east are the Russian car makers AVTOVAZ and GAZ.
